title: Intermediate Questions
terminalOutput:
# Example Answer for #2:
Standard middleware has 3 arguments: `(req, res, next)`. 
Error Handling middleware MUST have 4 arguments: `(err, req, res, next)`. Express specifically looks for the function signature with 4 parameters to designate it as the error catcher.
